summary: Authored the B2 ('sustained argument and spontaneous interaction') level blueprint against the shared curriculum master and level blueprint template: docs/curriculum/blueprints/b2.md and b2.json. 19 capabilities (13 required, 5 should, 1 optional) across 6 arcs, 20 new pattern groups, 3 proposed semantic types, an 88/67 vocabulary budget, and 4 declared core-engine requirements (discourse-coherence evaluation, register/pragmatic appropriateness as a separate dimension, an honest fallback for open argumentative turns, and meaning-preserved reformulation checking). Cross-level B1 prerequisites are provisional and namespaced b1.* pending LC-BP-B1/LC-AUD-001 reconciliation, flagged explicitly in the document rather than silently assumed. Design-only: no runtime module imports either file and product availability stays false.
